package.name: sig_proc_py
package.description:
Python signal processing node using siglib_py pybind11 bindings.
Mirrors sig_proc_cpp exactly — same topics, same filter parameters, same QoS — but implemented in Python via the pybind11 module.
Output must match sig_proc_cpp within stated tolerance: integer streams: bit-exact float streams: rtol=1e-6
Why have both C++ and Python nodes? Proves the pybind11 bindings are correct end-to-end. Python node is easier to prototype and visualise with. C++ node is faster for production deployment.
